_howto: Florida Division of Elections results extract (tab-separated), polled by server/src/adapters/fldos.js. extractUrl = the ResultsExtract.Asp download for one election date (OfficialResults=N: unofficial, PartyRaces=N: general-election races). One row per county x candidate; the statewide number is the sum of the 67 counties' rows for one race. Until the first rows appear the file is a header line only: the adapter then writes nothing. Set enabled:false to stop polling one without deleting it. Every contest in the extract is stored; races = headline races expected (coverage), not a filter. The extract is the Division's own contests (federal, statewide, legislative, multi-county, judicial retention, amendments); county and municipal contests are on the county Supervisor of Elections sites, so allContests is false. contestRules name FL offices the shared rules miss.
